name: Triparty Collateral Transaction Instruction Processing Status Advice V 01
definition: Scope: |This message is sent by a triparty agent after the receipt of a collateral instruction from its client.||In this message, the Sender is the triparty agent and the Receiver is either the collateral taker or the collateral giver or their account servicer.||Usage:|This message provides the status of the Triparty collateral transaction or instruction.

CancellationRequestReference.name: Cancellation Request Reference
CancellationRequestReference.definition: Reference to the unambiguous identification of the cancellation request as per the account owner.

Pagination.name: Pagination
Pagination.definition: Page number of the message and continuation indicator to indicate that the multi-part preliminary advice is to continue or that the message is the last page of the multi-part preliminary advice.

InstructionProcessingStatus.name: Instruction Processing Status
InstructionProcessingStatus.definition: Provides the status of an instruction.

MatchingStatus.name: Matching Status
MatchingStatus.definition: Provides the matching status of the instruction.

CancellationProcessingStatus.name: Cancellation Processing Status
CancellationProcessingStatus.definition: Provides the status of a cancellation request or status query.

GeneralParameters.name: General Parameters
GeneralParameters.definition: provides general information about the instruction and collateral transaction the message refers to.

CollateralParties.name: Collateral Parties
CollateralParties.definition: Identifies the chain of collateral parties.

DealTransactionDetails.name: Deal Transaction Details
DealTransactionDetails.definition: Specifies the information related to the deal.

DealTransactionDate.name: Deal Transaction Date
DealTransactionDate.definition: Identifies the dates related to the triparty collateral instruction or transactions.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

MatchingStatusPresenceRule.definition: If matching status is absent then instruction processing status or cancellation processing status must be present.

InstructionProcessingStatusPresenceRule.definition: If instruction process allocation status is absent then  matching status or cancellation processing status must be present.

CancellationProcessingStatusPresenceRule.definition: If cancellation processing status is absent then instruction processing status or matching status must be present.
